Great question! Here’s our return and refund policy!

Returns

Unused merchandise purchased on our website is eligible for a full refund within 30 days of receipt. Final Sale items aren’t eligible for return, refund, or exchange. Items must be unused, in original condition, and have tags attached. We reserve the right to approve returns and may refuse requests that don’t meet policy requirements.

Starting a Return

Go to the order status/return page and enter your order number, email address, and billing ZIP code, or log in and select the order. Your order must be received first. You’ll receive a return label by email, and you can also retrieve it from the order status page.

Refunds

Refunds go to the original payment method. After processing, allow 5–10 business days for the refund to appear, depending on your bank. Some institutions may take 1–2 billing cycles. Shipping charges aren’t refunded.

Retailer Purchases and Exchanges

Items purchased from a department or specialty retail store must be returned or exchanged with the original retailer. We don’t currently offer exchanges, but you can return the item for a refund and place a new order for a replacement!
